image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated within a stone archway, likely in a church or cathedral. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center creating a stepped silhouette. Below the pipes is a wooden gallery structure. At the bottom, there is a dark wooden enclosure (likely housing the console) and a black metal railing in the foreground. Light projects patterns onto the upper stonework.
